content.short: CreateDAO deploys a complete DAO, with token, treasury and governor, in a single transaction.
content.description: CreateDAO lets anyone deploy a full governance system, including a token, treasury and OpenZeppelin-based governor, in one transaction with no platform fee, using gas-efficient contract clones and auto-delegation. It runs a mini app inside World App, listed in World's ecosystem directory.
content.meta: CreateDAO deploys a full DAO (token, treasury, governor) in one transaction, with a World App mini app.
